Corrections to the seed list: Role Object is in PLoPD4 (confirmed live via InformIT ToC), not PLoPD3; PLoPD3's verified publication year is 1997 (often cited 1998); PLoPD1/2/5 not needed by this route. Seed 'bloch' (2006 API paper) membership was considered and rejected: it teaches API design generally but does not define any route element at catalog grade; Effective Java 3rd ed. added instead. Hook-method is covered by GoF's named 'hook operations' treatment in Template Method rather than by adding Pree's Meta Patterns (ECOOP 1994) unverified. Cunningham CHECKS and Grand's Patterns in Java were not needed — every element they would cover is already reached by stronger works. One living-catalog node each for Refactoring.Guru (22 GoF survey) and SourceMaking (sole catalog-grade Private Class Data source).
